tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded session logs in to the Magento 1.9 admin, navigates to the Manage Products grid, exercises all grid filters (ID range, Name, Type, Attribute Set, SKU, Price range, Qty range, Visibility, Status, Website), demonstrates Search and Reset Filter, interacts with pagination controls conceptually, and clicks a row checkbox and Edit link to reach the product edit page. Element indexes and element_hash values were observed, and we saw that previous failures came from an overly strict login selector (input[name="login[username]"][type="text"]).

Task Definition:
Create a reusable tool that, given Magento admin credentials and a set of catalog product filter parameters, will:
1) Navigate to the Manage Products grid (logging in if needed) using robust selectors,
2) Apply the specified filters and execute a Search,
3) Optionally adjust pagination (page/limit),
4) Optionally open the first product's Edit page,
5) Return structured page content for the filtered grid or the edit page.

Action Plan:
1) Navigation: Go directly to {base_admin_url}/admin/catalog_product/.
2) Robust Login (agent step): If login form is present, fill username/password using input[name='login[username]'] and input[name='login[password]'], submit via input[type='submit'], then wait for Manage Products grid to appear. If grid is already visible, skip.
3) Grid Filter Interactions (deterministic, CSS selectors):
   - ID From/To: input[name='entity_id[from]'], input[name='entity_id[to]'].
   - Name: input[name='name'].
   - Type: select[name='type'].
   - Attribute Set: select[name='set_name'].
   - SKU: input[name='sku'].
   - Price From/To: input[name='price[from]'], input[name='price[to]'].
   - Qty From/To: input[name='qty[from]'], input[name='qty[to]'].
   - Visibility: select[name='visibility'].
   - Status: select[name='status'].
   - Websites: select[name='websites'].
   These match the underlying Magento form field names while avoiding brittle visual indexes.
4) Click Search: button[title='Search'].
5) Wait for grid reload (fixed sleep to handle AJAX overlay that showed as element 118, "Please wait...").
6) Pagination Optimization: Instead of clicking the page input and next/prev controls, manipulate URL query parameters p (page) and limit (page size) using a navigation step with url_operation to replace or add these parameters; this is deterministic and simpler.
7) Optional Edit navigation: Use an agent step to click the first row's "Edit" link, because row structure and anchors may vary and element_hash is row-specific. Agent can reliably find the first tbody row and its Edit link.
8) Extraction: Use extract_page_content to capture either the resulting grid rows or, if navigated to edit page, the edit form content.

Variable Identification:
Inputs needed:
- base_admin_url: to construct URLs; derived from the starting URL ("http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php").
- admin_username/admin_password: credentials (constants in demo, but parameterize for reuse).
- entity_id_from/entity_id_to: map to entity_id[from]/[to] range.
- name: map to name filter.
- type_id: maps to select[name='type']; the actual visible label depends on this; we use an enum of Magento type codes and let the agent step or calling layer map to visible text, or directly pass visible text; here we document both.
- attribute_set_id: maps to select[name='set_name'] using visible text like "Default".
- sku: SKU filter.
- price_from/price_to: map to price range fields.
- qty_from/qty_to: map to qty range fields.
- visibility: select[name='visibility']; codes 1–4 with documented meanings.
- status: select[name='status']; codes 1/2.
- website_id: visible text for websites select (e.g., "Main Website").
- page: desired page number (maps to URL param p).
- limit: items per page (maps to URL param limit) with allowed values [20,30,50,100,200].
- open_first_edit: boolean flag controlling whether to open the first row's Edit page.

Step Optimization:
- Login: Instead of using a deterministic wait on a specific selector that failed previously, use an agent step that understands when the login form is present vs. already logged-in grid. Selector improvement: use input[name='login[username]'] without constraining type='text'. This directly addresses the failure log complaining that input[name='login[username]'][type='text'] was not found.
- Filters: Use precise name-based CSS selectors instead of positional indexes or element_hash; Magento's admin grid filter names are stable and unique, minimizing strict mode violations.
- Pagination: Replace UI clicking of "Page" input, next/previous links, and per-page dropdown with a single url_operation step that adjusts p and limit query parameters on {current_url}; this is deterministic and avoids ambiguous selectors.
- Edit link: Because row indices and edit link hashes vary, use an agent step instead of hardcoding an elementHash or index. The agent can simply select the first tbody > tr and click the anchor with text 'Edit'.
- Extraction: A single extract_page_content step at the end is sufficient; no need for multiple intermediate extractions in the tool.

The tool is single-purpose: search/filter and paginate the Manage Products grid (with optional first-row edit). Non-essential admin navigation, cache/security warnings, RSS links, and other menus are deliberately excluded.
name: tool_search_products_v4
description: Search Magento 1.x admin catalog products grid with full set of filters (ID range, name, type, attribute set, SKU, price range, qty range, visibility, status, website) plus pagination, and optionally open a product edit page. Includes robust login handling using stable selectors to avoid previous failures.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento admin login page (catalog_product URL will redirect to login if not authenticated).
Log into Magento Admin Panel using stable name-based selectors to avoid brittle type constraints, then wait until the Manage Products grid loads.
steps.task: On the current page, if a login form is visible, enter the admin credentials and submit the form, then wait until the "Manage Products" grid is displayed. Use these exact selectors where possible: username field input[name='login[username]'], password field input[name='login[password]'], and submit button input[type='submit'], but do NOT require the username field to have type='text'. Use the provided credentials: username={admin_username}, password={admin_password}. If the grid is already visible (user is logged in), skip login. Ensure you end on the Manage Products grid at {base_admin_url}/admin/catalog_product/.

steps.description: Set ID From filter (entity_id[from]) if entity_id_from is provided; otherwise leave field as is.
Set ID To filter (entity_id[to]) if entity_id_to is provided; otherwise leave field as is.
Set Name text filter (name) if provided.

Set Type select filter (type) by visible text corresponding to type_id, if provided and not empty. Common labels: 'Simple Product', 'Grouped Product', 'Configurable Product', 'Virtual Product', 'Bundle Product', 'Downloadable Product'.
Set Attribute Set select filter by visible text, e.g., 'Default', 'Books & Music', etc., if attribute_set_id is provided.
Set SKU text filter (sku) if provided.
Set Price From filter (price[from]) if provided.
Set Price To filter (price[to]) if provided.
Set Qty From filter (qty[from]) if provided.
Set Qty To filter (qty[to]) if provided.
Set Visibility select filter (visibility) based on provided code: 1=Not Visible Individually, 2=Catalog, 3=Search, 4=Catalog, Search. Use the appropriate visible label text for the option.
Set Status select filter (status) based on provided code: 1=Enabled, 2=Disabled. Use the visible label text.
Set Website select filter (websites) by visible text (e.g., 'Main Website') if website_id provided.
Click the Search button to apply all filters.
Wait for grid reload after applying filters (handles AJAX 'Please wait...' overlay).
Adjust pagination by manipulating URL parameters p (page) and limit (page size) based on inputs.
Wait for the paginated grid page to load fully.
Optionally open the first product's Edit page if open_first_edit is true by clicking its 'Edit' action link in the first data row.
steps.task: If open_first_edit is true, on the current Manage Products grid, find the first product row in the grid body and click its 'Edit' link in the Action column to open the product edit page. If open_first_edit is false or no rows exist, do nothing.

steps.description: Extract the resulting product grid (or product edit page) HTML/text for downstream processing, including product IDs, names, prices, and Edit URLs.
steps.goal: Extract all visible rows from the Manage Products grid with their columns (ID, Name, Type, Attribute Set Name, SKU, Price, Qty, Visibility, Status, Websites, Edit URL). If currently on a product edit page, instead extract the main product information (ID, Name, SKU, Status, Visibility, Websites) and any key attributes.

input_schema.name: base_admin_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Magento admin area without trailing slash, e.g. "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php"

input_schema.name: admin_username
input_schema.description: Magento admin username to log in, e.g. "admin"

input_schema.name: admin_password
input_schema.description: Magento admin password to log in, e.g. "password123"

input_schema.name: entity_id_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound of product ID range filter (entity_id[from])

input_schema.name: entity_id_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound of product ID range filter (entity_id[to])

input_schema.name: type_id
input_schema.description: Product Type select filter (type). Empty string for Any.

input_schema.name: attribute_set_id
input_schema.description: Attribute Set select filter value (set_name). Use the visible text like "Default", "Books & Music", etc.

input_schema.name: price_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound of Price range filter (price[from]) in current currency

input_schema.name: price_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound of Price range filter (price[to]) in current currency

input_schema.name: qty_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound of Quantity range filter (qty[from])

input_schema.name: qty_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound of Quantity range filter (qty[to])

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visibility select filter (visibility). Empty string for Any. Values: 1=Not Visible Individually, 2=Catalog, 3=Search, 4=Catalog, Search.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Status select filter (status). Empty string for Any. Values: 1=Enabled, 2=Disabled.

input_schema.name: website_id
input_schema.description: Website select filter (websites) visible text, e.g. "Main Website". Left empty for Any.

input_schema.name: page
input_schema.description: Page number in product grid pagination (p). Defaults to 1 if omitted.

input_schema.name: limit
input_schema.description: Products per page (limit). If omitted, Magento default (20) is used.

input_schema.name: open_first_edit
input_schema.description: If true, after applying filters the tool clicks the Edit link for the first row to open its product edit page.
